scope: Public upstream authored merged PRs; own repositories and Genesis-Embodied-AI excluded. Global totals include upstream repositories below the homepage >1,000-star display threshold. Four unavailable ONNX Runtime records retain their historical verification.

search_verification.method: Fresh complete identity enumeration of the entire public authored upstream merged-PR search, split into four disjoint creation-date ranges so every partition stays below GitHub's 1,000-result cap. All 20 pages were collected. The 1,728 search identities match the preceding inventory exactly except three known search omissions, individually revalidated via pull-request GET, and four historically verified unavailable ONNX Runtime PRs.
search_verification.search_merge_sha_note: Issue-search responses provide merged timestamps, not merge SHAs. Each enumerated identity's recorded merge SHA is retained from the pinned baseline unless explicitly verified by a fresh direct check.

supplemental_check.reason: An optional, redundant closure-window cross-check was rate-limited after successful full primary enumeration. No further request was made; this does not affect the complete four-partition result.

identity_encoding: Every number identifies https://github.com/{repository}/pull/{number}. The union of the three per-repository number lists is the complete inventory. Unchanged merge SHAs and titles remain in the pinned baseline sources; fresh direct checks include their own SHA receipts.
